sections.heading: Effect in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

claims.text: In patients with heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less, dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily reduced the composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death compared with placebo over a median of 18.2 months.

evidence.quote: Over a median of 18.2 months, the primary outcome occurred in 386 of 2373 patients (16.3%) in the dapagliflozin group and in 502 of 2371 patients (21.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.85; P<0.001).

claims.text: In patients with heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less, empagliflozin 10 mg once daily reduced the composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure compared with placebo over a median of 16 months.

evidence.quote: During a median of 16 months, a primary outcome event occurred in 361 of 1863 patients (19.4%) in the empagliflozin group and in 462 of 1867 patients (24.7%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio for cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, 0.75; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.86; P<0.001).

claims.text: The effect of empagliflozin on the primary outcome in heart failure with an ejection fraction of 40% or less was consistent regardless of the presence or absence of diabetes.

evidence.quote: The effect of empagliflozin on the primary outcome was consistent in patients regardless of the presence or absence of diabetes.

sections.heading: Effect in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction

claims.text: In patients with heart failure and an ejection fraction of more than 40%, empagliflozin 10 mg once daily reduced the composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure compared with placebo over a median of 26.2 months.

evidence.quote: Over a median of 26.2 months, a primary outcome event occurred in 415 of 2997 patients (13.8%) in the empagliflozin group and in 511 of 2991 patients (17.1%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.79; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.69 to 0.90; P<0.001).

claims.text: In patients with heart failure and an ejection fraction of more than 40%, the effect of empagliflozin was mainly related to a lower risk of hospitalization for heart failure.

evidence.quote: This effect was mainly related to a lower risk of hospitalization for heart failure in the empagliflozin group.

claims.text: In patients with heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction of more than 40%, dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily reduced the composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death compared with placebo over a median of 2.3 years.

evidence.quote: Over a median of 2.3 years, the primary outcome occurred in 512 of 3131 patients (16.4%) in the dapagliflozin group and in 610 of 3132 patients (19.5%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.82; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.73 to 0.92; P<0.001).

claims.text: In that trial of dapagliflozin in heart failure with a left ventricular ejection fraction of more than 40%, the incidence of adverse events was similar in the dapagliflozin and placebo groups.

evidence.quote: The incidence of adverse events was similar in the two groups.

sections.heading: Consistency across the ejection fraction spectrum

claims.text: Across five randomised trials of 21 947 participants, SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the risk of composite cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure, cardiovascular death, first hospitalisation for heart failure, and all-cause mortality.

evidence.quote: In the broader context of the five trials of 21 947 participants, SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the risk of composite cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure (0·77 [0·72-0·82]), cardiovascular death (0·87 [0·79-0·95]), first hospitalisation for heart failure (0·72 [0·67-0·78]), and all-cause mortality (0·92 [0·86-0·99]).

claims.text: In the meta-analysis, treatment effects for each studied endpoint were consistently observed both in the trials of heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction and across all five trials.

evidence.quote: These treatment effects for each of the studied endpoints were consistently observed in both the trials of heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction and across all five trials.

claims.text: In the meta-analysis, treatment effects on the primary endpoint were generally consistent across the 14 subgroups examined, including ejection fraction.

evidence.quote: Treatment effects on the primary endpoint were generally consistent across the 14 subgroups examined, including ejection fraction.

claims.text: In the trial of dapagliflozin in heart failure with a reduced ejection fraction, the frequency of adverse events related to volume depletion, renal dysfunction, and hypoglycemia did not differ between the treatment groups.

evidence.quote: The frequency of adverse events related to volume depletion, renal dysfunction, and hypoglycemia did not differ between treatment groups.

claims.text: Uncomplicated genital tract infection was reported more frequently with empagliflozin in the trial of patients with heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less.

evidence.quote: Uncomplicated genital tract infection was reported more frequently with empagliflozin.

claims.text: In the trial of patients with heart failure and an ejection fraction of more than 40%, uncomplicated genital and urinary tract infections and hypotension were reported more frequently with empagliflozin.

evidence.quote: Uncomplicated genital and urinary tract infections and hypotension were reported more frequently with empagliflozin.

pages.title: SGLT2 inhibitors in chronic kidney disease

claims.text: In patients with chronic kidney disease, dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily reduced the composite of a sustained decline in the estimated GFR of at least 50%, end-stage kidney disease, or death from renal or cardiovascular causes compared with placebo over a median of 2.4 years.

evidence.quote: Over a median of 2.4 years, a primary outcome event occurred in 197 of 2152 participants (9.2%) in the dapagliflozin group and 312 of 2152 participants (14.5%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.61; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.51 to 0.72; P<0.001; number needed to treat to prevent one primary outcome event, 19 [95% CI, 15 to 27]).

claims.text: In that trial, the effects of dapagliflozin were similar in participants with type 2 diabetes and in those without type 2 diabetes.

evidence.quote: The effects of dapagliflozin were similar in participants with type 2 diabetes and in those without type 2 diabetes.

claims.text: In that trial, the hazard ratio for the composite of death from cardiovascular causes or hospitalization for heart failure with dapagliflozin was 0.71.

evidence.quote: the hazard ratio for the composite of death from cardiovascular causes or hospitalization for heart failure was 0.71 (95% CI, 0.55 to 0.92; P = 0.009)

claims.text: In patients with chronic kidney disease at risk for disease progression, empagliflozin 10 mg once daily reduced the composite of progression of kidney disease or death from cardiovascular causes compared with placebo over a median of 2.0 years.

evidence.quote: During a median of 2.0 years of follow-up, progression of kidney disease or death from cardiovascular causes occurred in 432 of 3304 patients (13.1%) in the empagliflozin group and in 558 of 3305 patients (16.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001).

claims.text: In that trial, results were consistent among patients with or without diabetes and across subgroups defined according to eGFR ranges.

evidence.quote: Results were consistent among patients with or without diabetes and across subgroups defined according to eGFR ranges.

claims.text: In that trial, the rate of hospitalization from any cause was lower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group.

evidence.quote: The rate of hospitalization from any cause was lower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.78 to 0.95; P = 0.003)

claims.text: In that trial, there were no significant between-group differences with respect to the composite outcome of hospitalization for heart failure or death from cardiovascular causes or death from any cause.

evidence.quote: there were no significant between-group differences with respect to the composite outcome of hospitalization for heart failure or death from cardiovascular causes (which occurred in 4.0% in the empagliflozin group and 4.6% in the placebo group) or death from any cause (in 4.5% and 5.1%, respectively)

sections.heading: Canagliflozin in type 2 diabetes and nephropathy

claims.text: In patients with type 2 diabetes and albuminuric chronic kidney disease treated with renin-angiotensin system blockade, canagliflozin 100 mg daily reduced the composite of end-stage kidney disease, a doubling of the serum creatinine level, or death from renal or cardiovascular causes compared with placebo at a median follow-up of 2.62 years.

evidence.quote: The relative risk of the primary outcome was 30% lower in the canagliflozin group than in the placebo group, with event rates of 43.2 and 61.2 per 1000 patient-years, respectively (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.59 to 0.82; P = 0.00001).

claims.text: In that trial, the canagliflozin group also had a lower risk of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke and of hospitalization for heart failure.

evidence.quote: The canagliflozin group also had a lower risk of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke (hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.67 to 0.95; P = 0.01) and hospitalization for heart failure (hazard ratio, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.47 to 0.80; P<0.001).

claims.text: In that trial there were no significant differences in rates of amputation or fracture.

evidence.quote: There were no significant differences in rates of amputation or fracture.

claims.text: In DAPA-HF, 4744 patients with New York Heart Association class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less were randomly assigned to dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily or placebo in addition to recommended therapy.

evidence.quote: we randomly assigned 4744 patients with New York Heart Association class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less to receive either dapagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily) or placebo, in addition to recommended therapy

claims.text: In DAPA-HF, the primary outcome was a composite of worsening heart failure (hospitalization or an urgent visit resulting in intravenous therapy for heart failure) or cardiovascular death.

evidence.quote: The primary outcome was a composite of worsening heart failure (hospitalization or an urgent visit resulting in intravenous therapy for heart failure) or cardiovascular death.

claims.text: In DAPA-HF, findings in patients with diabetes were similar to those in patients without diabetes.

evidence.quote: Findings in patients with diabetes were similar to those in patients without diabetes.

claims.text: In DELIVER, 6263 patients with heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction of more than 40% were randomly assigned to dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily or matching placebo in addition to usual therapy.

evidence.quote: We randomly assigned 6263 patients with heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction of more than 40% to receive dapagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily) or matching placebo, in addition to usual therapy.

claims.text: In DELIVER, results were similar among patients with a left ventricular ejection fraction of 60% or more and those with a left ventricular ejection fraction of less than 60%, and in prespecified subgroups including patients with or without diabetes.

evidence.quote: Results were similar among patients with a left ventricular ejection fraction of 60% or more and those with a left ventricular ejection fraction of less than 60%, and results were similar in prespecified subgroups, including patients with or without diabetes.

claims.text: In DAPA-CKD, 4304 participants with an estimated GFR of 25 to 75 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 and a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio of 200 to 5000 were randomly assigned to dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily or placebo.

evidence.quote: We randomly assigned 4304 participants with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (GFR) of 25 to 75 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area and a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (with albumin measured in milligrams and creatinine measured in grams) of 200 to 5000 to receive dapagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or placebo.

claims.text: In DAPA-CKD, the independent data monitoring committee recommended stopping the trial because of efficacy.

evidence.quote: The independent data monitoring committee recommended stopping the trial because of efficacy.

claims.text: In DAPA-CKD, death occurred in 101 participants (4.7%) in the dapagliflozin group and 146 participants (6.8%) in the placebo group.

evidence.quote: Death occurred in 101 participants (4.7%) in the dapagliflozin group and 146 participants (6.8%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.53 to 0.88; P = 0.004).

claims.text: In EMPEROR-Reduced, 3730 patients with class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less were randomly assigned to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily or placebo in addition to recommended therapy.

evidence.quote: we randomly assigned 3730 patients with class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less to receive empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or placebo, in addition to recommended therapy

claims.text: In EMPEROR-Reduced, the total number of hospitalizations for heart failure was lower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group.

evidence.quote: The total number of hospitalizations for heart failure was lower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% CI, 0.58 to 0.85; P<0.001).

claims.text: In EMPEROR-Reduced, the annual rate of decline in the estimated glomerular filtration rate was slower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group.

evidence.quote: The annual rate of decline in the estimated glomerular filtration rate was slower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group (-0.55 vs. -2.28 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area per year, P<0.001)

claims.text: In EMPEROR-Preserved, 5988 patients with class II-IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of more than 40% were randomly assigned to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily or placebo in addition to usual therapy.

evidence.quote: we randomly assigned 5988 patients with class II-IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of more than 40% to receive empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or placebo, in addition to usual therapy

claims.text: In EMPEROR-Preserved, the effects of empagliflozin appeared consistent in patients with or without diabetes.

evidence.quote: The effects of empagliflozin appeared consistent in patients with or without diabetes.

claims.text: In EMPEROR-Preserved, the total number of hospitalizations for heart failure was lower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group.

evidence.quote: The total number of hospitalizations for heart failure was lower in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group (407 with empagliflozin and 541 with placebo; hazard ratio, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.61 to 0.88; P<0.001).

claims.text: In EMPA-KIDNEY, patients with chronic kidney disease were enrolled if they had an estimated GFR of at least 20 but less than 45 ml per minute per 1.73 m2, or an estimated GFR of at least 45 but less than 90 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 with a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio of at least 200.

evidence.quote: We enrolled patients with chronic kidney disease who had an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of at least 20 but less than 45 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area, or who had an eGFR of at least 45 but less than 90 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 with a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (with albumin measured in milligrams and creatinine measured in grams) of at least 200.

claims.text: In EMPA-KIDNEY, 6609 patients underwent randomization and the rates of serious adverse events were similar in the two groups.

evidence.quote: A total of 6609 patients underwent randomization.
The rates of serious adverse events were similar in the two groups.

claims.text: In CREDENCE, patients with type 2 diabetes and albuminuric chronic kidney disease received canagliflozin 100 mg daily or placebo, and all had an estimated GFR of 30 to <90 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 and albuminuria (ratio of albumin [mg] to creatinine [g], >300 to 5000) and were treated with renin-angiotensin system blockade.

evidence.quote: we assigned patients with type 2 diabetes and albuminuric chronic kidney disease to receive canagliflozin, an oral SGLT2 inhibitor, at a dose of 100 mg daily or placebo. All the patients had an estimated glomerular filtration rate (GFR) of 30 to <90 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area and albuminuria (ratio of albumin [mg] to creatinine [g], >300 to 5000) and were treated with renin-angiotensin system blockade.

claims.text: In CREDENCE, the trial was stopped early after a planned interim analysis on the recommendation of the data and safety monitoring committee.

evidence.quote: The trial was stopped early after a planned interim analysis on the recommendation of the data and safety monitoring committee.

claims.text: In CREDENCE, the relative risk of the renal-specific composite of end-stage kidney disease, a doubling of the creatinine level, or death from renal causes was lower by 34% with canagliflozin.

evidence.quote: The relative risk of the renal-specific composite of end-stage kidney disease, a doubling of the creatinine level, or death from renal causes was lower by 34% (hazard ratio, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.53 to 0.81; P<0.001)
